text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh, that is...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, Yaeno-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hello.
Out together, the two of you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um... well... er...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san, do you have a moment?
Would you care to join me for some tea?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“—We have just now
returned from the hospital.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I was just checking on the progress of an injury.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see. Is everything progressing smoothly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
She is recovering.
However... her return is expected to take quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I see...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"When I asked when I'd be able to race again,
they told me they didn't know..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Panicking won't do any good.
For now, I'll prioritize recovery,
and I will definitely return to the turf one day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Though maybe no one's actually
waiting for me, but..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
!? What are you saying?!
There's no way that—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“Still... with me not running in races,
just how many people
even remember my name...?”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The more time passes,
the more forgotten I'll become...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —I will, no matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I am here!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"If only I, who competed against you both in the Classic Triple Crown,
kept on running—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Each time, the crowd will surely be reminded of both of your runs!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I will protect the place both of you return to!
I'll keep your memories alive with my running!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Yaeno-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, how dependable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now we can focus on treatment with peace of mind too.
Right, Chiyono O-san?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I'm sorry for saying
something so pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it everything I've got!
Please wait for me!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
I'll be waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —I will run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I told her she had been voted among the top in the Arima Kinen fan poll and asked if she wanted to enter—
Yaeno Muteki replied instantly.
choice_data_list: We still have concerns about the distance—is that really okay?
I'm still worried about the distance—is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is 2,500 meters long,
so I express my concerns regarding her stamina.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Fully aware and understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Curious about her unusually stubborn demeanor, I decided to ask her about it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Actually...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki said that by running herself,
she wanted to keep the memory of Sakura Chiyono O and the others alive in people's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Since the Arima Kinen is the grand culmination of the year,
I believe it serves as the perfect catalyst to jog memories.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To be honest... I do not know if someone like me, unable to reach such a strong "obsession", is fit for such a grand role, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Since I am to run, I intend to pour every ounce of my strength into it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, they will also
be running in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must fight... as one who has competed
in the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A huge crowd packed the venue today as well, all eager to witness the showdown between Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This enthusiasm surpasses even the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No matter the form it takes,
being in the spotlight is a stroke of good fortune.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let us be on our way.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross!!
Let the "White Lightning" roar again today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Go for it, Oguri!!" his

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo! You're the strongest!!
Don't you go givin' that up to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Show them your true strength!
Oguri Cap!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah! Waaaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...A frenzy of pure ecstasy.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I must not waver. Do not be unsettled by the clamor.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Set aside all anguish for now,
and temper both raging fire and still water.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Now, let the match begin!
